name: DataForSEO: live SEO data (extension)
description: Live SEO data via DataForSEO MCP server: SERP analysis, keyword research (volume, difficulty, intent, trends), backlink profiles, on-page analysis, competitor and content analysis. It gives the agent a clearer input/output frame for search and SEO workflows: what context to ask for, what decisions to make, and what usable artifact to return.
